title: Training Questions: The Vehicle-Amendment Line Charge on Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing Certificates
content:
**Q1. What sets the line charge on a vehicle amendment?**
The vehicle endorsements recorded on the named insured's Cardinal Personal Auto Policy records within the past month. The line charge is worked out from the vehicle-amendment rate:

| Vehicle endorsements recorded within the past month | Vehicle-amendment line charge |
|---|---|
| A vehicle replacement was recorded | Twice the rate — the rate is charged for each of the two vehicle lines the amendment prints, the vehicle coming on and the vehicle going off |
| No replacement, but a vehicle removal was recorded | Half the rate, rounded down to the whole dollar |
| Otherwise — an addition only, or no vehicle endorsement | The rate, once |

**Q2. What is "within the past month"?**
A one-month window covers the endorsements whose recorded date is less than one whole month before today, whole months being counted from the recorded date to today.

**Q3. A replacement and a removal were both recorded this month. Which line applies?**
The first line: a replacement was recorded, so the line charge is twice the rate.

**Q4. Can you show the figures? (hypothetical rates)**

| Rate | Replacement recorded | Removal only | Addition only or none |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10.00 | 20.00 | 5.00 | 10.00 |
| 15.00 | 30.00 | 7.00 (half is 7.50, rounded down) | 15.00 |
| 20.00 | 40.00 | 10.00 | 20.00 |

**Q5. Does the rounding apply to the replacement line?**
No. Rounding down to the whole dollar belongs to the half-rate line only; twice the rate and the rate once are taken as they stand.
